title: Real-Time AI Video
description: What works in real-time AI video: models, workflows, hardware, latency, quality, and cost.
evidence_scope: Dated primary sources, reproducible reports, and clearly identified measurements and estimates.
methodology_summary: Compare model and workflow versions with their hardware, cost, quality, and latency conditions.
question: What can generate continuous, interactive AI video today, and which setups work at which cost, latency, hardware requirements, and quality?
